output.subject: scaling your london outbound team
output.body:
I saw Kestrel Labs is hiring four Sales Development Representatives for your new outbound team in London. "Half of our pipeline already comes from the UK," Aoife Byrne said, adding "Being in London lets us meet those customers in person." Scaling that team without adding more SDR headcount can be tough, especially as generic sequences see declining reply rates. Would you be open to a 15‑minute call to explore how an outbound pipeline engine could support your growth?
Priyanshu
